newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Stanley Works cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Stanley Works cut to hold.

text.p: NatWest Securities said Monday it lowered its rating on shares of Stanley Works to hold from accumulate.
-- Analyst James Lucas said Stanley Works's new business plan, announced on Friday, would take some time to implement.
-- The tool and hardware marker said it would cut 4,500 jobs and reduce its manufacturing and distribution facilities to 70 from 123.

-- "It was a very detailed business plan...but it will affect 1999 and beyond," Lucas said. "While it will generate a big cost savings, a lot of those savings will be reinvested, so we won't see near-term benefit to the bottom line."
